answer: Influence is stake squared times tenure. Tenure accrues one unit per tide survived clean - counted only when the liveness signal verifies and audits find nothing. The inlet grants no backlog: tenure binds to the key, resets on transfer; age cannot be bought. Splitting punishes itself: 800 clones staking 5 weigh 1/800th of one account staking 4000 at equal tenure, and parity costs 800 times the wait - 800 identities funded through 800 times the veteran's streak. Attacker cost scales as clone count times waiting time; patience cannot be parallelized.
